thread:
maya (ml): Canary for cinder13b-int4 went live. Seeing two quick issues: intermittent OOMs on long sessions and small drop in accuracy on chained-reasoning prompts. Repro steps below.

ben (infra): OOM logs show many small allocations failing after steady-state fragmentation, not one giant alloc. stack: `kv_alloc -> grow_kv_pool -> cudaMalloc`.

kai (serving): Quick mitigation: enable cudaMallocAsync, reduce default_max_new_tokens to 480, and lower prefetch_window from 768->384. Also turn on slot_compaction every 120s.

fran (evals): Initial quality delta vs fp16: accuracy -0.7% on chain-reasoning dataset, mainly when context > 1500 tokens. Running full 2k-prompt eval targeting long-context subset.

lee (sre): Repro locally: 48GB A100, seq=4096, batch surge to 10 -> OOM in ~25s. With prefetch=384 + max_new_tokens=480, can't reproduce in 6/6 runs.

maya (ml): Also noticed batch efficiency drops above batch 6. Propose defaults: batching_target_window_ms=22, batching_max_batch=10, batching_target_batch=5.

kai (serving): Patch config: `default_max_new_tokens=480`, `prefetch_window=384`, `allocator.use_cudamallocasync=true`, `slot_compact_interval_s=120`, `kv_align_mb=2`, batching params as maya suggested. Rolling to canary (3 hosts) for 2h.

deploy-bot: rollout started: r-2026-1796000000-1 -> canary (3/12).

ben (infra): After 30m: p50 190ms (baseline 160ms), p95 430ms (baseline 400ms). Memory steady ~36GB, spikes to 44GB. No new OOMs so far.

fran (evals): Mid-run results: quality gap reduced to -0.2% with patched defaults; remaining failures concentrated on multi-step math prompts. Full report ETA 45m.

lee (sre): Action items: add mem_frag_ratio metric, alert at >0.11; add emergency fallback to cinder7b-lite if allocator fails twice in 60s.

maya (ml): If final eval looks ok and 2h canary stays clean, we'll keep onboarding defaults and add note about long-context caveat for int4.

kai (serving): Also adding runtime heuristic: sessions with avg_gen_length>1200 get soft-reduced max_new_tokens to avoid repeated large KV growth.

ben (infra): I'll add dashboard tiles for kv_alloc_rate and slot_compactions.

maya (ml): Repro command: `rcli bench --model cinder13b --quant int4 --seq 4096 --batch 8 --max_new_tokens 1024 --allocator=cuda_async --out cinder-repro.log` (use patched defaults to mirror canary).

fran (evals): Final: eval pass looks good, quality delta within noise. Proceeding to expand rollout after 2h clean window.
